capabilities: Add wiki-links to notes and create concept notes via LLM processing
Translate notes and selections with configurable target language
Research and summarize web topics via Tavily or DuckDuckGo
Generate content from note titles, singly or in batches
Generate, preview, and export diagrams in Mermaid, Drawnix, Draw.io, Vega-Lite, and other formats
extras: DuckDuckGo search and the diagram pipeline are labeled experimental; mobile devices and Obsidian 0.15.0 are noted as unverified. Presentation export requires a specific Slidev fork. Documentation is split across an external documentation hub; the plugin accepts donations via Buy Me a Coffee.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in way to use LLMs for automatic concept linking, content generation, translation, or diagram creation across notes.

relations.evidence: Generated Mermaid artifacts are now validated with mermaid.parse before the renderer returns them
Perform web searches using Tavily (requires API key) or DuckDuckGo (experimental)
Runs models locally via Ollama server

requires.name: LLM provider API key (e.g. OpenAI, Anthropic, DeepSeek)
local model server (Ollama or LM Studio) for local providers

summary: LLM-powered knowledge tool that adds wiki-links, creates concept notes, translates, researches topics, and generates diagrams from vault notes.
